summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts, core-shell, sub-route-billing and sub-route-reports (reports also used it) in one PR (#1), since shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time (no registry release or dependency bump needed). Bumped shared-contracts to 2.0.0 as a breaking change. All three apps built locally; CI and CD green. Assumption: single PR is fine as no ordering is needed.
